description.zh: 报警规则ID，可调用SearchAlertRules接口查询，对应返回参数`Id`，详情请参见[SearchAlertRules](~~175825~~)。
description.en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the SearchAlertRules operation and view the `Id` parameter in the response. For more information, see [SearchAlertRules](~~175825~~).
The ID of the region. Set the value to `cn-hangzhou`.
